2609.03528.title: LeanGRPO: Eliminating Redundant Recomputation in Diffusion RL
2609.03528.paper_summary: Diffusion reinforcement learning (RL) has recently achieved significant success in post-training image and video generative models. However, most diffusion RL methods, including DanceGRPO and FlowGRPO, recompute selected timesteps with gradient tracking after rollout. Under on-policy training with the same backend for rollout and update, this recomputation is mathematically redundant. Intuitively, the rollout and policy update steps can reuse the same feed-forward backbone to avoid redundant computation, but doing so can incur a large memory overhead during rollout. To address the issue, we present LeanGRPO by restructuring the data-parallel layout and introducing two recompute-free training schedules for trajectory-logprob diffusion RL: (1) LeanGRPO-Retain enables gradient tracking during rollout and directly reuses the resulting computation graphs and saved activations for backward during update, requiring no recomputation; and (2) LeanGRPO-Reweight also enables gradients during rollout, but immediately backpropagates each selected step using a provisional advantage and delays gradient synchronization, then corrects the provisional gradients with the true advantage after the trajectory is completed. These schedules target different model scales and input sizes. Across FlowGRPO/DanceGRPO with FLUX.1-dev and Wan, LeanGRPO achieves up to 1.83x end-to-end speedup while preserving the original optimization objective.
2609.03528.paper_summary_zh: 擴散強化學習（RL）最近在後訓練的圖像和視頻生成模型中取得了顯著成功。<lb/>然而，大多數擴散RL方法，包括DanceGRPO和FlowGRPO，在推出後重新計算選定的時間步驟並進行梯度追蹤。在使用相同的後端進行推出和更新的在線策略訓練中，這種重新計算在數學上是冗餘的。<lb/>直觀地說，推出和策略更新步驟可以重用相同的前饋骨幹，以避免冗餘計算，但這樣做在推出期間可能會產生大量的內存開銷。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們通過重構數據並行佈局並引入兩種無需重新計算的訓練計劃來提出LeanGRPO，用於軌跡-對數概率擴散RL：<lb/>(1) LeanGRPO-Retain在推出期間啟用梯度追蹤，並直接重用結果計算圖和保存的激活進行更新時的反向傳播，無需重新計算；<lb/>(2) LeanGRPO-Reweight也在推出期間啟用梯度，但立即使用臨時優勢反向傳播每個選定步驟並延遲梯度同步，然後在軌跡完成後用真實優勢修正臨時梯度。<lb/>這些計劃針對不同的模型規模和輸入大小。在FlowGRPO/DanceGRPO與FLUX.1-dev和Wan的比較中，LeanGRPO實現了高達1.83倍的端到端加速，同時保留了原始的優化目標。
